mapper.select: SELECT b.benefit_id, b.benefit_title, b.benefit_summary, b.benefit_description, b.benefit_icon_url FROM benefit b WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_deleted = false ORDER BY b.benefit_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit ( card_id, benefit_title, benefit_summary, benefit_description, benefit_icon_url, is_deleted, created_at, deleted_at, last_modified_at ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{request.title}, #{request.summary}, #{request.description}, #{request.iconUrl}, false, NOW(), null, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit SET benefit_title = #{request.title}, benefit_summary = #{request.summary}, benefit_description = #{request.description}, benefit_icon_url = #{request.iconUrl}, last_modified_at = NOW() WHERE benefit_id = #{benefitId}
UPDATE benefit SET is_deleted = true, deleted_at = NOW(), last_modified_at = NOW() WHERE card_id = #{cardId} AND benefit_id = #{benefitId} AND is_deleted = false
